presentation.title: SQX Lab
presentation.job: Author native blocks, groups, templates, and projects from your StrategyQuant X install.
presentation.detail: Four install-derived authoring skills. They emit native SQX artifacts. They do not replace AlgoWizard or run inside this desktop.
presentation.opens_in: Native authoring, not a TraderCockpit workspace

controls.label: SQX install
controls.detail: Point the skills at the authorized 144.2953 runtime.

controls.label: Skill chain
controls.detail: Block, then group, then template, then project.

presentation.title: Custom Block authoring
presentation.job: Emit validated native Condition and Price-level blocks for AlgoWizard.
presentation.detail: Authoring aid for native custom blocks. TraderCockpit does not re-code RSI/ATR or invent a block engine.
presentation.opens_in: Native authoring, not a TraderCockpit workspace

controls.label: Install catalog
controls.detail: Derived from the authorized StrategyQuant X install.

presentation.title: RunCompare
presentation.job: Compare each backtest run against the last one and keep a history per strategy name.
presentation.detail: StrategyQuant X Results plugin. Change one thing, rerun, and see what got better or worse. History stays in SQX, not in this desktop.

controls.label: Strategy name
controls.detail: Give each strategy a unique name so histories do not mix.

controls.label: Run notes
controls.detail: Type what you changed on each backtest row inside SQX.

presentation.title: LucidFlex Prop Evaluator
presentation.job: Ask whether a backtest would pass a LucidFlex futures evaluation or survive funded.
presentation.detail: Replays native trades through LucidFlex rules inside StrategyQuant X Results. This desktop does not invent a PASS/FAIL.
presentation.opens_in: StrategyQuant X → Results → LucidFlex Prop Evaluator

controls.label: Account Type
controls.detail: Evaluation (target + consistency) or Funded (survive trailing max loss).

controls.label: Account Size
controls.detail: $25K, $50K, $100K, or $150K with that tier's real limits.

controls.label: Size Multiplier
controls.detail: Scale trade P&L and contracts relative to the backtest.

presentation.title: Edge Decay Analyzer
presentation.job: Score edge quality and measure how much it decays from in-sample to out-of-sample.
presentation.detail: StrategyQuant X Results plugin. Select a strategy in the databank, then read the score and IS vs OOS decay there.
presentation.opens_in: StrategyQuant X → Results → Edge Decay Analyzer

controls.label: Selected strategy
controls.detail: The plugin follows the databank selection inside SQX.

controls.label: OOS period
controls.detail: Needs an out-of-sample window on the native result.

presentation.title: 2-Step Challenge Analyzer
presentation.job: Ask whether a strategy would pass a two-phase prop evaluation on this backtest.
presentation.detail: StrategyQuant X Results plugin. Verdict and Monte Carlo stay in SQX. A backtest PASS is not a live PASS.

controls.label: Strategy
controls.detail: Portfolio stream or one strategy from the databank.

controls.label: Sample
controls.detail: Full, In-Sample, or Out-of-Sample. OOS is the honest test.

controls.label: Max-loss floor
controls.detail: Static minus 10% from start, or trailing with equity highs.

presentation.title: Source Code Translator
presentation.job: Read native strategy source from the Results tab in StrategyQuant X.
presentation.detail: SQX Results extension package. Install into the authorized runtime, then use it inside SQX. This desktop does not decompile strategies.
presentation.opens_in: StrategyQuant X → Results → Source Code Translator

controls.label: Selected strategy
controls.detail: Translator follows the strategy selected in SQX.
